description: The dependency edges of the governance inventory (decision W15-8): the document reads (kind document) and the code imports (kind code) of the U15 research addendum D4 section 5.1, each with its stated source, plus the two code imports that C02 and C20 add (built after the addendum, W15-18). A related link (a page statement, a shared method, a shared source, a measurement, a conceptual link) is listed apart and is never a dependency. Every entry also depends on the engine node riskvalidation (implicit, W15-8). An edge is written between cases; the bake expands it to entries: the upstream is the reference entry of the upstream case (the entry that holds the manifest's default variant, else the first fit by key), the downstream is every entry of the downstream case, because every fit runs the same code or reads the same documents. Each edge lists the lines the edge test checks (a downstream file that stops naming the upstream document or module, or an import line that goes away, fails the test).
